svg.title: Helios battery port | isolated power transfer study
svg.text: Rev A | Dual active bridge | Power-path study for simulation
Positive transfer: battery to common link.
Bus isolation and precharge precede enable.
50 kHz; phase shift sets direction and power.
180 uH primary magnetizing inductance in model.
700 V study point. Generic switches only.
Each gate requires a source-referenced driver.
Link capacitors and faults need separate design.
Simulation boundary: stiff DC rails. No physical gate drives, fusing, isolation coordination or switching-device selection on this sheet.
POWER CIRCUIT STUDY / Not released for fabrication or energization
